[12:25PM] #OrileIganmu #TrafficUpdate 

There is heavy vehicular movement from White Sand heading toward Iganmu Bridge. Similarly, traffic is busy from the Ijora 7Up axis down to IVECO, also inward toward Iganmu Bridge.

The ongoing road rehabilitation work on top of Iganmu Bridge is contributing to the congestion. Traffic remains busy descending the bridge toward Contain Bus Stop due to the same repair activity.
Traffic alternation is currently in effect on Iganmu Bridge to manage the flow.
